sentences.text: Hoy escribo sobre mi primera semana en Honduras.
sentences.english: Today I am writing about my first week in Honduras.

sentences.text: El lunes fue mi primer día en la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: Monday was my first day at doña Marta's house.

sentences.text: Todo es diferente: la comida, la gente, la lluvia y el idioma.
sentences.english: Everything is different: the food, the people, the rain and the language.
My life here is different.
The house is different.
When I arrived, I did not understand anything.

sentences.text: Doña Marta habló mucho, y yo miré a doña Marta.
sentences.english: Doña Marta talked a lot, and I looked at doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Sam, do you want coffee or water?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Coffee, thank you, doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Entonces, aquí estás en tu casa.
sentences.english: So, here you are at home.
Last night I had dinner with the family.

sentences.text: Terminé de cenar muy cansado, pero feliz.
sentences.english: I finished eating dinner very tired, but happy.
The language is difficult.
There are many new words.
There is a lot that I do not understand.

sentences.text: Luis es maestro, y Luis me ayuda.
sentences.english: Luis is a teacher, and Luis helps me.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Luis, I have a question.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What does "ahorita" mean?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: It means "in a moment".

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And "luego"?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: "Luego" means "afterwards".

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Now I understand.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How difficult!

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: If you have a question, ask it.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Claro que es difícil, pero vas a aprender.
sentences.english: Of course it is difficult, but you are going to learn.
I ask questions every day.

sentences.text: Luis o Ana me ayuda cuando hablo mal.
sentences.english: Luis or Ana helps me when I speak badly.

sentences.text: Hablo con doña Marta, y ella dice: "Seguí, Sam, seguí."
sentences.english: I talk with doña Marta, and she says: "Keep going, Sam, keep going."

sentences.text: Es fácil hablar con ella, porque ella me ayuda.
sentences.english: It is easy to talk with her, because she helps me.

sentences.text: Doña Marta cocina como mi mamá.
sentences.english: Doña Marta cooks like my mom.

sentences.text: Aquí me siento como en mi casa.
sentences.english: Here I feel like I am at home.
I want to learn the language.

sentences.text: Hablo como un cipote: poco y mal.
sentences.english: I speak like a little kid: little and badly.

sentences.text: Un día fui a la pulpería con Nico.
sentences.english: One day I went to the shop with Nico.
Nico is my friend.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Good morning, ma'am.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How much does the bread cost?

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.english: It costs five lempiras.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Give me two, please.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.english: Nothing else?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Nothing else, thank you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Sam, you speak well.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I speak little, but I speak.

sentences.text: Aquí me gustan los frijoles, el arroz, el plátano y la tortilla.
sentences.english: Here I like beans, rice, plantain and tortilla.
I drink coffee and I drink water.

sentences.text: Ana, Luis y Nico son mis amigos.
sentences.english: Ana, Luis and Nico are my friends.
They help me a lot.

sentences.text: El sábado caminé al centro con Ana.
sentences.english: On Saturday I walked to the center with Ana.
There I talked with a woman.

sentences.text: La señora vendió pan, y yo compré pan.
sentences.english: The woman sold bread, and I bought bread.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sam, tengo un regalo para vos.
sentences.english: Sam, I have a present for you.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Es un libro pequeño de palabras.
sentences.english: It is a small book of words.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Thanks, Ana!

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is it possible to read now?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Of course, but first have some coffee.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: All right.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I drink coffee and read.

sentences.text: El domingo fue el último día de la semana.
sentences.english: Sunday was the last day of the week.
We went to church.

sentences.text: Después, doña Marta cocinó frijoles o pollo.
sentences.english: Afterwards, doña Marta cooked beans or chicken.
We all had dinner.

sentences.text: Hoy aprendí una palabra nueva: pulpería.
sentences.english: Today I learned a new word: pulpería.

sentences.text: No es fácil, pero es fácil hacer amigos aquí.
sentences.english: It is not easy, but it is easy to make friends here.

sentences.text: Si llueve, me quedo en la casa.
sentences.english: If it rains, I stay at the house.

sentences.text: Si hace sol, voy al centro.
sentences.english: If it is sunny, I walk to the center.

sentences.text: Cuando llega el viento y el frío del invierno, quiero estar con doña Marta.
sentences.english: When the wind and the cold of winter come, I want to be with doña Marta.

sentences.text: Después de la lluvia, hay sol y hay menos frío.
sentences.english: After the rain, there is sun and less cold.

sentences.text: Ayer escribí a mi familia sobre el viaje al mar.
sentences.english: Yesterday I wrote to my family about the trip to the sea.

sentences.text: Quiero volver al mar y seguir con mis visitas.
sentences.english: I want to go back to the sea and keep making my visits.
It is possible, of course.

sentences.text: Escribo esto en el último momento del domingo.
sentences.english: I am writing this in the last moment of Sunday.

sentences.text: La última noche de la semana, doña Marta oró por mí.
sentences.english: On the last night of the week, doña Marta prayed for me.

sentences.text: Ya tengo una semana en Honduras, y tengo mucho que aprender.
sentences.english: I already have a week in Honduras, and I have a lot to learn.

sentences.text: Mañana es lunes de nuevo, y voy a trabajar con el equipo.
sentences.english: Tomorrow is Monday again, and I am going to work with the team.

sentences.text: Voy a visitar a una familia con el pastor y con Ana.
sentences.english: I am going to visit a family with the pastor and with Ana.

sentences.text: Luis dice que el equipo es grande, y que todos necesitan ayuda.
sentences.english: Luis says the team is big, and that everybody needs help.

sentences.text: Yo también necesito ayuda, pero ahora tengo amigos y tengo paz.
sentences.english: I need help too, but now I have friends and I have peace.

sentences.text: Quiero hablar más, escribir más y ayudar más.
sentences.english: I want to speak more, write more and help more.
Thank you, God, for this week.
